notes: Original algorithm source is unchanged; explicit compatibility Cargo.lock uses Rust 1.75.0, LLVM 6.0.1 and 130 checksum-locked crates.

The initial private cold compilation reached final linking; a second successful attempt resumed its target after adding only a private linker name for the existing host libtinfo.so.6. Both actual attempts are preserved.
Runtime requires Linux x86_64 and host GNU C/C++ libraries, libz.so.1 and libtinfo.so.6; the produced ELF has a measured GLIBC_2.38 requirement. No binary compatibility with older hosts is claimed.
Source rebuilds additionally use the three immutable Rust component archives in the common support bundle; each rebuild independently extracts its own SDK, sources, vendor, Cargo home and target.
Qualification covers the recorded i64 programs and host. It makes no general optimizer-correctness, cross-library performance, platform or official benchmark claim.
